concept.title: The Status Column
concept.shortdesc: One of the columns in the score sheet is called "Status". Here is what that means!

conbody.p: "Status" refers to how the team competed. "CO" means completed and designates a team that competed completely normally, no issues. "PO" means participated: the team showed up but did not complete a test and therefore could not be assigned a raw score. "NS" means no show, and is used for teams that do not show up to the test. "DQ" means disqualified, and should only be applied to a team with the tournament director(s)'s approval.
